intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Côte des Terrasses (112.8 km)

story: After a prolonged battle to establish the breakaway, several groups managed to go clear. Pedersen collected maximum points at the intermediate sprint, strengthening his lead in the points classification. Five riders later emerged from the break and reached the final climb together, where Carapaz launched the decisive attack to claim the stage victory.
